meta.name: Parson Russell Terrier First Year Costs
meta.excerpt: The Parson Russell Terrier is one of the more affordable small breeds to own, with modest food costs and minimal grooming expenses. Here's a complete first-year cost breakdown.
meta.meta_description: Parson Russell Terrier first year costs: puppy price, food, vet care, training, and supplies. Budget $2,000–$4,000 for year one with this energetic working...

hero.alt: Adult Parson Russell Terrier relaxing at home in a family setting

intro.label: Upfront Costs
intro.heading: Upfront Costs of Getting a Parson Russell Terrier
intro.html:
Puppy Price: $1,000–$2,500. From a responsible breeder who performs DNA health testing for PLL and Late Onset Ataxia, eye clearances, and BAER hearing testing. Show-quality dogs from champion lines may be priced higher.

Crate: $40–$75. A 24–30 inch crate appropriate for this small breed.

Dog Bed: $30–$60. Washable and durable.

Collar, Leash, Harness: $30–$60. Small adjustable collar, no-pull harness, 4–6 foot leash.

Bowls: $15–$35. Stainless steel food and water bowls.

Initial Vet Visit: $200–$400. Puppy exam, vaccines, deworming, flea/tick prevention, microchipping.

Spay/Neuter: $200–$400. Timing at 12 months is typical for small breeds.

care.label: First Year Recurring
care.heading: Recurring First Year Costs
care.html:
Food: $25–$45/month ($300–$540/year). Small-breed high-quality dry food for a 13–17 lb dog. Very affordable due to small size.

Veterinary Care: $300–$500/year. Routine wellness, vaccines, and preventives.

Training and Dog Sports: $200–$600/year. Puppy class, basic obedience, and ideally a sport class (agility is a natural fit for this breed). Investment in training pays significant dividends with a Parson Russell.

Grooming: $50–$150/year. Mostly manageable at home. Professional grooming 1–2 times per year for rough/broken coats. Smooth coats can be managed entirely at home.

Pet Insurance: $20–$40/month ($240–$480/year). Recommended given PLL risk. Enroll while young and healthy.

Toys and Enrichment: $80–$150/year. Active dogs benefit from durable toys, puzzle feeders, and flirt poles.

special.label: Total & Ongoing
special.heading: First Year Total and Long-Term Costs
special.html:
Estimated First Year Total: $2,000–$4,000

Including purchase price and first-year expenses. The Parson Russell is one of the more economical terriers to own.

Ongoing Annual Costs (Year 2+): $1,200–$2,000/year.

Lifetime Costs: Over a 13–15 year lifespan, total ownership costs typically run $18,000–$32,000 — among the more affordable purebred options when accounting for longevity.

faq.q: How much does a Parson Russell Terrier puppy cost?
faq.a: $1,000–$2,500 from a reputable health-testing breeder is typical.

faq.q: Are Parson Russell Terriers cheap to maintain?
faq.a: Yes, they are one of the more affordable small breeds. Small size means low food and medication costs, and minimal grooming needs keep those expenses minimal. Primary variable costs are veterinary care and dog sport participation.
